model.name: ServerManagerGuard.seedOwnerInto
model.description: seedOwnerInto(allowedUsers: string[]): string[] — ADDS the hardcoded OWNER_TOKEN to the passed allowedUsers array (idempotent — units already carry [41ad88c4]) and RETURNS the array. The OWNER_TOKEN value is NEVER returned bare / NEVER exposed to callers (least-exposure; the guard does the add internally). NOT a getOwnerToken() accessor. Lives on ServerManagerGuard next to assertOwner so the OWNER_TOKEN literal AND its sole seed-use are co-located = grep-guard still ==1 (INV-G2).
